ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_rank_weighted_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_repaired_v6
ir.intuition: This loss implements a stable pairwise ranking loss that avoids gradient saturation by applying a softplus transform to the advantage gap. It normalizes weights to maintain stable scaling and clamps margins and rank gaps to ensure gradients remain meaningful, enabling robust preference alignment.
ir.pseudocode:
weight_mean_eps = mean(weight) + 1e-6
weight_norm = weight / weight_mean_eps
adv_gap_softplus = softplus(advantage_gap)
margin_raw = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
margin_clamped = clamp(margin_raw, -4, 4)
rank_raw = rank_gap(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
rank_pos = max(rank_raw, 1.0)
weighted_adv = adv_gap_softplus * weight_norm
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(margin_clamped) * rank_pos * weighted_adv
loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight_mean_eps = ops.add(ops.mean(weight), 1e-6)
    weight_norm = ops.div(weight, weight_mean_eps)
    adv_gap_softplus = ops.softplus(adv_gap)
    margin_raw = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin = ops.clamp(margin_raw, -4.0, 4.0)
    rank_raw = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)
    rank = ops.max(rank_raw, ops.ones_like(rank_raw).mul(1.0))
    weighted_adv = ops.mul(adv_gap_softplus, weight_norm)
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(ops.mul(ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin)), rank), weighted_adv)
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
